title: Actual RibaMod positive-groundwater forcing next-boundary allocation bridge

discriminating_memory_only_alternative.derivation: 32 m3/day fixed source + 21.97488887434318 m3 accepted storage memory, with current positive drainage omitted from the forecast.

hypotheses: The first four 6-hour accepted states reproduce the qualified DUMMY-20F2 day-1 physical prefix.
The fifth product step carries the active approximately 7.999872 m3/day passive groundwater drainage into Ribasim before the t=24 fixed allocation solve is advanced.
The actual allocation output contains distinct t=0 and t=24 records.
The actual t=24 allocation is root=40 and external=20 m3/day.

The actual t=24 external allocation is materially above the preregistered memory-only alternative 13.9748888743 m3/day, demonstrating current positive groundwater forcing admission in addition to accepted memory.
External physical supply is zero through t=24 and becomes positive in the first post-boundary segment.
The source + groundwater = UserDemand + Basin-storage ledger closes at every observed boundary.
